accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 came into force on:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 came into force on 1 March 2014.
accepted.tq: Use the exact commencement date rather than the better-known date of State bifurcation.
accepted.sec: National project status - APRA Section 90, executing authority, consent and clearances  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the clearances specifically associated with the Central Government's responsibility under Section 90(4) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
accepted.x: Section 90(4) refers to environmental, forest and rehabilitation and resettlement clearances. Mining lease clearance is not included in the stated provision.
accepted.tq: Find the item outside the exact statutory list rather than relying on general project requirements.
accepted.sec: National project status - APRA Section 90, executing authority, consent and clearances  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In actual implementation, which authority executes the irrigation component of the Polavaram Project on behalf of the Government of India?
accepted.x: Although the Central Government is responsible under Section 90(4), the Government of Andhra Pradesh executes the irrigation component on behalf of the Government of India and claims reimbursement or advance from the Centre.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the statutory responsibility of the Union from the agency carrying out execution in practice.
accepted.sec: National project status - APRA Section 90, executing authority, consent and clearances  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to Central funding of the Polavaram Project, consider the following statements:
1. The Centre funds 100 per cent of the remaining cost of the irrigation component from 1 April 2014.
2. The commitment covers the drinking-water component in the same manner as the irrigation component.
3. The hydel component is not covered by this commitment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Centre funds 100 per cent of the remaining irrigation-component cost from 1 April 2014. Drinking-water and hydel components are not covered by this commitment.
accepted.tq: Split the funding commitment by component and watch for the reversed coverage trap.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The cut-off date from which the Centre funds 100 per cent of the remaining cost of the irrigation component of the Polavaram Project is:
accepted.x: The Central funding commitment for 100 per cent of the remaining irrigation-component cost operates from 1 April 2014.
accepted.tq: Separate the funding cut-off date from the dates of enactment and bifurcation.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following figures represents the older revised cost estimate cited in bifurcation-related discussions for the Polavaram Project?
accepted.x: The older revised cost estimate cited in the bifurcation-related material is ₹55,548 crore. Delays were associated with revised cost estimate checks, land acquisition and rehabilitation and resettlement funding.
accepted.tq: Match the figure with its financial context instead of confusing estimates, pending amounts and allocations.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As of December 2025, which pair correctly represents the expenditure incurred and the Government of India advance mentioned for the Polavaram Project?
accepted.x: The expenditure was reported as ₹25,700.47 crore, while the Government of India advance was ₹5,052.71 crore as of December 2025.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of expenditure and advance; the reversed pair is the principal trap.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 provided which amount for the revised cost of the Polavaram Project, with storage up to 41.15 metres?
accepted.x: The Union Budget 2026–27 provided ₹3,320 crore for the revised cost, associated with storage up to 41.15 metres.
accepted.tq: Link the budget allocation to its stated storage level and distinguish it from the previous year's approximate amount.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the amounts associated with the Centre's pending assistance and Andhra Pradesh's demand for Polavaram Phase-II?
accepted.x: About ₹12,000 crore was reported as pending from the Centre, while Andhra Pradesh sought ₹32,000 crore for Polavaram Phase-II and permanent lifting of the MoEF stop-work order.
accepted.tq: Keep the pending amount and the State's demand in their stated order.
accepted.sec: Polavaram funding - Centre's share, cut-off date, cost revisions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Polavaram Project Authority was constituted primarily to:
o: Oversee the national project, route national-project funding and mediate inter-State coordination
Administer only the hydel component of the project
Replace the Government of Andhra Pradesh as the sole executing agency for every component
Transfer all submerged villages to Telangana
accepted.x: The Polavaram Project Authority was constituted by the Union after the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 to oversee the national project, route national-project funding and mediate inter-State coordination.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional role from its functions rather than from the name of the body.
accepted.sec: Polavaram Project Authority (PPA) - constitution, CEO, role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following combinations is correctly matched with the Polavaram Project Authority?
o: Member-Secretary — M. Raghuram; Chief Engineer at Rajamahendravaram — M. Ramesh Kumar
Member-Secretary — M. Ramesh Kumar; Chief Engineer at Rajamahendravaram — M. Raghuram
Member-Secretary — Shiv Nandan Kumar; Chief Engineer at Rajamahendravaram — M. Raghuram
Member-Secretary — M. Raghuram; Chief Engineer at Rajamahendravaram — Shiv Nandan Kumar
accepted.x: M. Raghuram is the Member-Secretary, and M. Ramesh Kumar is the Chief Engineer at Rajamahendravaram. Shiv Nandan Kumar was identified as the CEO as of 25 May 2024.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure designation-name pair and reject the options that swap offices.
accepted.sec: Polavaram Project Authority (PPA) - constitution, CEO, role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Polavaram Project Authority is correct?
1. The CEO's office is located in New Delhi.
2. The Authority was constituted by the Union after the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
3. The Authority has a role in inter-State coordination.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Authority was constituted after the Reorganisation Act, performs inter-State coordination functions, and the CEO sits in New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-location-function combination and test all three independent attributes.
accepted.sec: Polavaram Project Authority (PPA) - constitution, CEO, role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014, commonly referred to in this context as the Polavaram Ordinance Bill, primarily amended the territorial provision so as to:
o: Merge Odisha's submergence villages with Andhra Pradesh
Transfer the entire Khammam district to Andhra Pradesh
Transfer Bhadrachalam temple town to Andhra Pradesh
Keep the Khammam villages and mandals in the submergence area with Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The Ordinance amended the territorial provision so that Khammam villages and mandals in the Polavaram submergence area remained with Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the limited territorial transfer from the incorrect claim of transferring an entire district.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the base territorial rule in the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, Khammam was assigned to Telangana, except for:
o: Villages notified after 2014 by the Polavaram Project Authority
All villages situated along the Godavari River
Villages listed in G.O.Ms. No. 111 dated 27 June 2005
accepted.x: The base rule assigned Khammam to Telangana but excluded the villages listed in G.O.Ms. No. 111 dated 27 June 2005. Bhurgumpadu, Seetharamanagaram and Kondreka stayed in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the notification number and date to separate the base rule from the later Ordinance.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT one of the seven mandals moved from Khammam to Andhra Pradesh under the Polavaram-related territorial arrangement?
accepted.x: The seven mandals included Kukunoor, Velerupadu, VR Puram, Chintoor, Kunavaram, Bhadrachalam except the temple town, and Burgampadu. The Bhadrachalam temple town itself was excluded.
accepted.tq: Look for the stated exception within the otherwise transferred Bhadrachalam area.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Commencement of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014
B. Issue of G.O.Ms. No. 111
C. Passage by the Lok Sabha of the Bill transferring seven mandals
D. Constitution of the Polavaram Project Authority after the Reorganisation Act
accepted.x: G.O.Ms. No. 111 was issued on 27 June 2005, the Act came into force on 1 March 2014, the Lok Sabha passed the Bill on 11 July 2014, and the Authority was constituted after the Act.
accepted.tq: Fix the dated notification and parliamentary event first, then place the post-Act institutional event.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Following the transfer of the seven mandals, the area of Andhra Pradesh increased approximately from:
accepted.x: The area of Andhra Pradesh rose from 1,60,205 square kilometres to 1,62,970 square kilometres after the transfer of the seven mandals.
accepted.tq: Check both the direction and the exact endpoints of the area change.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of States, other than Telangana, objected in relation to Polavaram submergence and protective embankments?
accepted.x: Odisha and Chhattisgarh objected in connection with protective embankments, while Telangana raised the issue of backwater at Bhadrachalam.
accepted.tq: Group the neighbouring States by the specific inter-State issue associated with them.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which issue was specifically associated with Telangana in relation to the Polavaram Project?
o: Objection to the 960 MW hydel capacity
Demand for the Right Main Canal
Failure to construct the spillway in Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: Telangana's stated objection concerned backwater at Bhadrachalam. Odisha and Chhattisgarh were associated with protective-embankment concerns.
accepted.tq: Match each neighbouring State to its distinct objection instead of combining all objections.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: During the Godavari–Sabari floods in 2026, approximately how many villages in the Polavaram district submergence zone were placed on alert?
accepted.x: Approximately 189 villages in the submergence zone of Polavaram district were placed on alert during the 2026 Godavari–Sabari floods.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the flood-alert village count from the separate drinking-water village figure.
accepted.sec: Submergence - Khammam mandals (Polavaram Ordinance), other States affected  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Polavaram Project is situated on the:
accepted.x: The project is located on the Godavari River near Polavaram village in Eluru district.
accepted.tq: Combine the river and site identifiers to avoid confusing the project with its water-transfer destination.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the principal dam and spillway dimensions of the Polavaram Project?
o: Earth-cum-rock fill dam of 1,121.20 m and spillway of 2,467.50 m
Concrete dam of 2,467.50 m and spillway of 960 m
Earth-cum-rock fill dam of 2,467.50 m and spillway of 1,121.20 m
Earth-cum-rock fill dam of 960 m and spillway of 80 m
accepted.x: The project has a 2,467.50-metre earth-cum-rock fill dam and a 1,121.20-metre spillway.
accepted.tq: Keep the structure type and the two measurements paired in their correct order.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the water and irrigation features of the Polavaram Project:
1. The gross reservoir capacity is 194.6 TMC.
2. The utilisation capacity is 322.73 TMC.
3. The project is designed to irrigate 7.20 lakh acres.
4. The irrigation command includes East and West Godavari, Eluru, Krishna and Visakhapatnam.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The irrigation potential of 7.20 lakh acres is equivalent to 2.91 lakh hectares, and the listed districts are covered by the irrigation system.
accepted.tq: Check the capacity figures, area conversion and district list as separate statements.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: The installed hydel capacity of the Polavaram Project is:
o: 80 MW through 12 units of 960 kW each
960 MW through 8 units of 120 MW each
120 MW through 12 units of 10 MW each
960 MW through 12 units of 80 MW each
accepted.x: The hydel component has an installed capacity of 960 MW, comprising 12 units of 80 MW each.
accepted.tq: Use the unit-wise multiplication to distinguish the approved configuration from the incorrect alternative figure.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the Polavaram water-transfer and drinking-water provisions?
o: 23.44 TMC is transferred to the Krishna through the Right Main Canal and 80 TMC is earmarked for Visakhapatnam
28.5 TMC is transferred to the Krishna through the Right Main Canal and 23.44 TMC is earmarked for hydel generation
80 TMC is transferred to the Krishna through the Right Main Canal and 23.44 TMC is earmarked for Visakhapatnam
80 TMC is transferred to the Krishna through the Left Main Canal and 28.5 TMC is earmarked for Visakhapatnam
accepted.x: The project transfers 80 TMC of Godavari water to the Krishna through the Right Main Canal and provides 23.44 TMC for Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Separate the transfer quantity, canal and destination from the drinking-water allocation.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: The drinking-water provision of the Polavaram Project is intended to serve approximately:
accepted.x: The project provides 23.44 TMC for Visakhapatnam, intended to serve approximately 28.5 lakh people in 540 villages.
accepted.tq: Do not confuse the beneficiary population and village count with irrigation and flood-alert figures.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which canal of the Polavaram Project feeds the Krishna delta?
accepted.x: The Right Main Canal carries water towards and feeds the Krishna delta. The Left Main Canal carries water towards Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the two similarly named canals by their destinations.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the two main canals is correct?
o: The Left Main Canal is used only for hydel generation and the Right Main Canal only for drinking water.
The Right Main Canal carries water to Visakhapatnam, whereas the Left Main Canal feeds the Krishna delta.
The Right Main Canal feeds the Krishna delta, whereas the Left Main Canal carries water to Visakhapatnam.
Both the Right and Left Main Canals feed only the Krishna delta.
accepted.x: The Right Main Canal feeds the Krishna delta, while the Left Main Canal carries water to Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-destination trap to distinguish the two canals.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: The approved Full Reservoir Level (FRL) of the Polavaram Project is:
accepted.x: The approved Full Reservoir Level of the project is 45.72 metres. The 41.15-metre figure is associated with storage mentioned in the 2026–27 budget context, not the approved FRL.
accepted.tq: Separate the approved FRL from another project-related storage level.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with the history of the Polavaram Project?
o: First contemplated in 1941 — started in 2005 under Jalayagnam
First contemplated in 2005 — started in 1941 under Jalayagnam
First contemplated in 2014 — started in 2026 under Jalayagnam
First contemplated in 1941 — started in 2014 under the Polavaram Ordinance
accepted.x: The project was first contemplated in 1941 and was started in 2005 under the Jalayagnam programme.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence with the two historical years and reject the swapped chronology.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: The proposal for the Polavaram Project was named “Ramapada Sagaram” by:
accepted.x: Sir Sonti Venkataramamurthy named the proposal “Ramapada Sagaram.”
accepted.tq: Match the historical name with its proposer rather than with a present project official.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the Polavaram Project is correct?
o: It is located in Krishna district and draws water from the Pennar River.
It is located in Visakhapatnam district and has no irrigation component.
It is located in Eluru district, which was earlier identified as part of West Godavari district.
It is located in Khammam district and transfers Krishna water to the Godavari.
accepted.x: The project is near Polavaram village in Eluru district; the site was earlier identified with West Godavari district. It is a Godavari project with substantial irrigation and water-transfer components.
accepted.tq: Use the present district name together with the earlier district identity to resolve the location change.
accepted.sec: Project features - river, district, reservoir, canals, hydel
